dataset_name: Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) GRD Radiometrically Terrain Corrected (RTC)
provider: European Space Agency (ESA) Copernicus / Microsoft Planetary Computer
ner_coverage: Full NER coverage across ascending/descending relative orbits
format: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) via SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC)
access_method: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API + Windowed COG reads
use_in_system: All-weather surface roughness, soil moisture backscatter (VV/VH), and flood inundation change
known_limitations: SAR shadow and layover along extreme northern facing Himalayan mountain scarps
